meta.name: adr
meta.description: Architecture Decision Records - the project's design knowledge base. CONSULT ADRs before planning any feature or architectural change. Use when (1) planning implementation, (2) modifying core systems, (3) asked why something works a certain way, (4) making significant technical decisions. ADRs explain WHY choices were made. Also use when asked to write, record, supersede, or amend an architecture decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 记录和追溯项目的架构决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要解释和回顾项目中的技术选择。
copy.tagline_en: Record and review your project's technical decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall why technical choices were made.

howto.what: Claude 会先查看项目里的架构决策记录(ADR),规划功能或改动时遵循已有决策;若你的计划与 ADR 冲突,会停下来和你确认。需要时会起草新的 ADR,写入磁盘前会征得你同意。
howto.when: 当你规划实现、改动核心系统、询问某个行为为何如此、做出重大技术决策,或要求撰写/修改/废弃某条架构决策时触发。

say.text: 先查一下我们项目里关于支付模块的架构决策记录。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并阅读相关 ADR 后再规划。

say.text: 我打算改缓存方案,先看看有没有相关 ADR 会冲突。
say.note: Claude 会对照现有决策,发现矛盾会先和你讨论。

say.text: 帮我把“引入消息队列”这条决策记成一条新的 ADR。
say.note: Claude 会起草 ADR 草案,确认后写入文件。

howto.what_en: Claude first looks up Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) in the project and follows existing decisions when planning features or changes. If your plan conflicts with an ADR, it stops and checks with you. It can draft new ADRs and will ask before writing any file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you plan implementation, modify core systems, ask why something works a certain way, make significant technical decisions, or ask to write, record, supersede, or amend an architecture decision.

say_en.text: Check our architecture decision records about the payment module first.
say_en.note: Claude searches and reads relevant ADRs before planning.

say_en.text: I'm thinking of changing the caching strategy. See if any ADR conflicts.
say_en.note: Claude compares against existing decisions and flags conflicts.

say_en.text: Record 'introduce a message queue' as a new ADR.
say_en.note: Claude drafts the ADR and confirms before writing.
